description: Get one part (Artikel) by its sevDesk id: Artikelnummer, name, description (Beschreibung), unit, prices, tax rate, internal note and stock (Bestand), including the current stock from sevDesk's stock endpoint when stock tracking (Lagerbestand) is on. Use it after sevdesk_parts_list. Unit ids resolve with sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=units.
name: sevdesk_part_get
title: Get a sevDesk part
